name: Oswald Cloch Crochta
description: Played in the first session (11 October 2026). [[npc/marcos|Marcos]]'s own surgeon; no more is known of it. Has a donkey ([[creature/oswalds-donkey|Oswald's donkey]]), which by the end of the first session was pulling [[pc/blindy|Blindy]]'s cart. Rolled a 2 for his background. His sheet calls his d6 weapon a knife (the Barber-Surgeon's is a bonesaw).

name: Siofra
description: Played in the first session (11 October 2026). Rides [[creature/lasarine|Lasarine]]. Noted on the sheet: "villain / hero (mercenary)". Rode on north alone from the [[place/bridge-of-saints|Bridge of Saints]] before the goblins came ([[event/siofra-rides-north|Siofra rides on north]]). Rode as [[npc/marcos|Marcos]]'s guard as he travelled the region ([[event/siofra-guards-marcos|Siofra guards Marcos]]), which gave her some insight into his studies and discoveries: how much is unknown.

name: Blindy
description: Played in the first session (11 October 2026). "Glic" is also written on the sheet. Talked the goblins at the [[place/bridge-of-saints|Bridge of Saints]] into running downriver ([[event/goblins-sent-downriver|The goblins are sent downriver]]). Obtained [[document/marcos-map|the map]] for [[npc/marcos|Marcos]], by means she has never explained ([[event/blindy-obtains-the-map|Blindy obtains the map]]). **Secret:** known only to Blindy.

name: Greg Sayers
description: Played in the first session (11 October 2026). Read of the Seven Spheres in [[document/the-suppression-of-magic|The Suppression of Magic]], a book he found at [[place/island-monastery|the island monastery]] where he worked as a scribe. It is vague about what the spheres are for, but he knows each one could set him up for life. He met [[npc/marcos|Marcos]] and told him what he had learned ([[event/greg-tells-marcos|Greg Sayers tells Marcos of the spheres]]). Kept for himself [[itemtype/the-cathedral-and-the-canopy|The Cathedral and the Canopy]], a storybook whose margins tell how to travel, eat and sleep in the cloud forests. Rolled a 20 for his background, and notes that he knows ancient texts. He wrote out [[document/marcos-will|Marcos's will]] and brought it to Marcos's acquaintances. His sheet left out the Scrivener's torch (3 uses); he has it, as the background gives.
